facts.text: The hotel is set directly above Platis Gialos beach.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is situated directly above this beach which is beloved for its fine sand, crystal waters, charming boutiques, and quaint restaurants along the boardwalk.

facts.text: Platis Gialos Bay is about five kilometres (three miles) from Mykonos Town.
facts.excerpt: Platis Gialos Bay is just five kilometres (three miles) from Mykonos Town, known locally as Chora.

facts.text: The beaches of Psarou, Paranga and Agia Anna and the Scorpios promontory are a short stroll away.
facts.excerpt: A short stroll away, the beaches of glamorous Psarou, Paranga, and Agia Anna await, along with the iconic promontory where ultra-cool Scorpios holds court.

facts.text: Glass-bottom boat rides and private yacht charters depart from the hotel's jetty.
facts.excerpt: Glass-bottom boat rides and private yacht charters depart from our jetty

facts.text: The Grand Suite sits atop a hill with a veranda and an all-marble pool with views.
facts.excerpt: Perched atop a hill, this 35m² retreat features a 20m² veranda and a 40m² all-marble pool with breathtaking views.

facts.text: The Emblematic Suite is at the highest point of the hillside, with a veranda, a marble pool and a pergola.
facts.excerpt: Nestled at the highest point of the hillside, this 35m² retreat offers a 20m² veranda and a 40m² marble pool with expansive views.

facts.text: Premium rooms come with a balcony or terrace with seating, a private Jacuzzi or a private pool.
facts.excerpt: Options include a balcony/terrace with seating, private Jacuzzi, or private pool.

facts.text: Signature Suites have a broad terrace with a private Jacuzzi, a freestanding bath and a rain shower.
facts.excerpt: Relax on the broad terrace with a private Jacuzzi or enjoy the Aegean views from your plush bed. Includes a freestanding bath, rain shower, and seating area.

facts.text: The Villa has eight bedrooms, a landscaped garden and a terrace with a pool and Jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: An eight-bedroom Myconian paradise blending island charm with modern luxury. Panoramic views, hardwood floors and a landscaped garden complement flexible layouts for up to 18 guests.

facts.text: Rooms have marble floors, warm wood accents, all-white tones with blue, and designer lighting.
facts.excerpt: Marble floors, crisp linens, and warm wood accents complement all-white tones and classic blue. Designer lighting creates a serene ambiance

facts.text: The Thalasso Spa has steam rooms and Thalasso pools with varying temperatures and salinity.
facts.excerpt: Steam rooms, Thalasso pools with varying temperatures and salinity, exclusive products, and expert therapists await.

facts.text: Spa therapists work with Elemis, St. Barth and Augustinus Bader products.
facts.excerpt: Our therapists work with three award-winning ranges: Elemis, the leading British spa and skincare brand

facts.text: The gym includes a Pilates Reformer, with private Pilates and yoga sessions available.
facts.excerpt: Our fitness gym features the latest in exercise systems, including a Pilates Reformer. Private sessions are available for both Pilates and yoga.

facts.text: Yoga sessions include sunrise or full moon yoga and sunset sessions paired with meditation.
facts.excerpt: secret sunrise or full moon yoga, and sunset sessions paired with meditation

facts.text: The pool deck has sweeping Aegean views.
facts.excerpt: The pool deck feels like a world of its own, with sweeping Aegean views and a sense of complete relaxation.

facts.text: Yacht charters from the hotel's launch at Platis Gialos can visit Delos, with a private guided tour and swimming in Rhenia's waters.
facts.excerpt: Take a private guided tour before swimming and snorkelling in Rhenia’s pristine waters.

facts.text: Helicopter rides fly over Mykonos, Delos and Rhenia toward Tinos, Paros and Naxos.
facts.excerpt: Fly over Mykonos, its sunbaked landscape dotted with whitewashed houses, then sweep across Delos and Rhenia before heading towards Tinos, Paros, and Naxos

facts.text: Efisia restaurant is set in a stone alcove with sea views.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in a stone alcove with sea views, Efisia is a culinary destination in the Relais & Châteaux tradition

facts.text: George's Bar is named after founder George Daktylides and has panoramic sea views.
facts.excerpt: Named after founder George Daktylides, George’s Bar is the perfect vantage point to watch the day unfold. Panoramic sea views set the scene

facts.text: A private cooking class with chef Ilias Maslaris starts with a morning market round.
facts.excerpt: Join our chef, Ilias Maslaris, on his morning round to source the freshest organic vegetables from the market and exclusive suppliers

facts.text: The boutique next to the lobby carries Greek and international designers.
facts.excerpt: visit our boutique next to the lobby. Our handpicked selection features leading Greek and international designers

facts.text: Fresh beach towels are available daily at reception.
facts.excerpt: Fresh beach towels are available daily at reception.
